does_not_exclude: gravity-restored hydrodynamic pulsation with pressure and thermal forces
nonradial orbital motion with angular momentum
proof: A nonconstant continuous periodic function attains a local minimum. At a twice-differentiable minimum, R_ddot is non-negative. The inverse-square equation requires R_ddot<0 for all positive R. The conditions contradict.
scope: gravity-only radial equation with constant positive enclosed mass and no outward force
statement: No nonconstant twice-differentiable positive periodic radius R(t) can satisfy R_ddot=-G*M/R^2 for constant G>0 and M>0 at every time.
